senses.gloss: m. (קפף; cmp. Syr. קופא vectis, P. Sm. 3551) 1) lever, carrying pole.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 4:12">Targ. Y. Num. IV, 12</cite> (h. text <cite ref="M00460"><he>מוֹט</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 13:23">Targ. Y. II ib. XIII, 23</cite> <cite ref="S00501"><he>קוֹפָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 109b:6">B. Mets. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ סבא פלגא</he> (Ms. H. <cite ref="S01695"><he>קַפָּא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6) of the trunk of an old vine (that is cut down) the gardener gets an even share with the tenant.

<cite ref="Chullin 110a">Ḥull. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ סבא הוה</he> Ar. (Ms. H. <cite ref="S02049"><he>קי׳</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10; missing in ed.) it was an old trunk.—Pl. <cite ref="S00493"><he>קוֹפָאֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 24a:14">B. Bath. 24ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="S00493"><he>בי ק׳</he></cite> (Ms. F. <he>קַפָּאֵי</he>) between the trunks of vines.

senses.gloss: that which hangs on the carrying pole.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 111a:2">Ḥull. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>קניא בקופיה</he> (Ar. <he>בקַפֵּיה</he>) the windpipe with all that hangs on it (lungs, heart &c.).
